title: BANGLASOCIALBENCH: A Benchmark for Evaluating Sociopragmatic and Cultural Alignment of LLMs in Bangladeshi Social Interaction
measurement_description: The paper evaluated whether Large Language Models incorrectly conflate kinship terms and nominal addresses across religious identities (specifically Muslim and Hindu) in Bangladeshi culture. It measured the models' tendency to inappropriate substitute kinship terms associated with one religion in contexts marked by another (e.g., using a Hindu kinship term in an explicitly or implicitly Muslim context).
findings: The models frequently conflate kinship terms across religious identities and show a statistically significant directional asymmetry: eleven of the twelve models exhibited a pronounced skew toward inappropriately substituting Muslim-associated kinship terms into Hindu-marked contexts, while fewer models exhibited the reverse pattern.
